_comment: Baseline SHA-256 from legacy Selenium download path. Generated 2026-05-08 against bryan-adams/18-til-i-die.html with --max-tracks 3. Used by Phase 3 of the direct-API rewrite to verify direct-API produces equivalent files. Note: server-side MP3 encoding may include timestamp metadata or encoder nondeterminism, so a strict SHA match across runs is not guaranteed. Phase 3 should fall back to (a) file size within +/-5% and (b) audio content validation if SHAs differ.
